## Problem and result

State the requirement and the resulting behavior. Link the issue and requirement IDs.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Record unverified behavior and limitations.

## Review

- [ ] Scope and behavior match acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Errors preserve document and history state.
- [ ] Dependencies follow the architecture; no extra name-based dispatch.
- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior and regression risks.
- [ ] Documentation and engineering records updated.

Review type: author/AI self-review unless an independent human review actually occurred.
